messages:
ryan: FYI: smallpool throughput dropped ~40% around 09:12 PST. Multiple worker restarts + GPU OOMs. Opening thread.

deploy-bot: [ALERT] smallpool: p99 latency 3.1s -> baseline 0.7s; restart spike 09:12-09:18

anika: Looking at perf traces now. Initial sign: kernel-selection count jumps for long sequences.

ben: Can you paste the stack from the busiest worker?

anika: paste logs:
```
[09:12:05] worker-17: CUDA OOM while allocating 1.2GB for matmul_tmp
[09:12:05] worker-17: fallback to generic kernel matmul_generic
[09:12:06] worker-17: eviction: kv_cache dropped 324 entries
```

maya: kv eviction spike matches increased sequence length distribution — lots of chat completions > 1024 tokens.

liam: Did canary optimizer roll out last night? It touched kernel heuristics and batching.

ryan: Yes, canary 'kernel-heuristic-v3' rolled at 02:30. Rollback candidate?

anika: Profiling shows kernel-heuristic-v3 prefers 'fast_matmul_v1' but falls back to 'matmul_generic' when memory>70% due to allocation pattern. Fallbacks are thrashing allocator.

ben: So sequence length + fallback -> KV cache churn -> more mem -> OOM -> restarts. Chain reaction.

maya: Quick mitigation: 1) pin kernel to stable 2) increase kv_cache soft limit 3) revert canary.

ryan: Initiating rollback of kernel-heuristic-v3 on smallpool now.

deploy-bot: Deploy triggered: rollback kernel-heuristic-v3 to kernel-heuristic-v2 on smallpool by ryan

sre-bot: Autoscale note: scaled smallpool +2 nodes to let draining complete

~3 min later

anika: After rollback: worker restarts stopped, GPU mem utilisation steady, kv evictions back to baseline.

ben: Throughput back to ~98% of baseline. p99 latency down to 0.75s.

ryan: Leaving thread open for postmortem. Assigning owners: anika (invest), ben (root-cause write), maya (config follow-ups).

maya: Also adding a regression test for kernel fallbacks in nightly perf.

ryan: Thanks all. Follow-up doc in #postmortems next 24h.
